reason: The native direct-API full-visible positive control failed before live append or restored capsule semantics could be interpreted.
raw_label_note: Raw codeword records may contain preliminary labels such as model_weakness or semantic_restore_failure. Those labels are retained only as raw harness output and are superseded by this experiment-level stop-rule classification.
why_not_model_weakness: Prior server full-visible/documented-cache codeword controls passed on the same pinned GPT-OSS family; the native direct-API path has not yet established prompt/template/sampler/generation parity.
why_not_semantic_restore_failure: Restored-capsule controls cannot be interpreted when the native full-visible positive semantic control is already failing with the same response-hash pattern.
invalid_excluded_runs: An earlier codeword attempt produced empty-batch decode errors before batch.n_tokens was set; those records were deleted/excluded and are not represented in committed summaries.

classification_rules.native_server_parity_failure: Use for full_visible_prefix_plus_tail in this run because the direct API path did not reproduce prior server full-visible behavior.
classification_rules.untested_due_to_failed_native_full_visib: Use for native live/restored append controls because their semantics are uninterpretable after positive-control failure.
classification_rules.fresh_tail_expected_miss_not_decision_re: Use for fresh tail-only negative controls; expected miss, but not decision-relevant after positive-control failure.
classification_rules.raw_model_weakness_or_semantic_restore_f: Do not quote as final interpretation; these were preliminary raw harness labels superseded by stop-rule analysis.

full_visible_prefix_plus_tail.interpretation: Native direct-API positive control failed; classify as native/server prompt-generation parity failure, not model weakness.

fresh_tail_only.interpretation: Expected negative control and not decision-relevant after positive-control failure.

native_live_append_tail_only.interpretation: Not interpreted because native full-visible positive control failed first.

native_restored_capsule_append_tail_only.interpretation: Not interpreted because native full-visible positive control failed first; not a semantic restore failure claim.
